title: C process_dio treats incomparable DODAG versions as equal
description:
Security review of lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c version compare (post-y4yy RFC 7.2 lollipop_cmp). Not a re-file of y4yy/k35h/s0wq: lollipop_cmp itself now matches RFC SEQUENCE_WINDOW=16; the DIO call site ignores incomparable.

## Bug

lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio (dodag.c ~354-365) only branches on version_is_newer(dio, local) or version_is_newer(local, dio). RFC 6550 7.2 same-region |a-b| > 16 is incomparable (lollipop_cmp returns 2). Then both version_is_newer calls are false (except the documented 0 vs 127 special case), and the function falls through and processes the DIO as if the versions were equal: DTSN update, parent insert, select_parent. adopt_version is not called, so d->version is unchanged.

Unjoined nodes always adopt (second if is true whenever !joined), including older and incomparable versions for the same DODAGID.

## Attacker model

DIO version is an attacker-controlled uint8_t. process_dio requires authenticated=true (valid link signature / TOFU peer). A signed neighbor can:

1. After the victim joined at version V, send a DIO with version V+/-17 (same region) so |diff| > 16.
2. Become a parent in the victim's table while the victim keeps version V.
3. Optionally bump DTSN (ret=1) and mix poisoned topology into a desynchronized DODAG.

Python (dodag.py process_dio + versions_incomparable) and rust/lichen-rpl (version_is_older_or_incomparable -> Rejected) drop incomparable DIOs. python/tests/rpl/test_dodag.py test_incomparable_version_is_ignored_not_mixed and test_joined_node_ignores_incomparable_version_parent encode that oracle. C host test lichen/tests/rpl_dodag only exercises the helpers, not this call site.

## Acceptance

- JOINED + incomparable incoming version: no parent insert, no DTSN change, version unchanged.
- UNJOINED + same (instance, DODAGID) + older or incomparable: do not adopt_version.
- Add C tests with the Python/Rust incomparable vectors as independent expected values (not derived from dodag.c).
close_reason: lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio now ignores incomparable lollipop versions (neither version_is_newer, versions not equal): no parent insert, no DTSN update, version unchanged. UNJOINED + same (instance, DODAGID) + older/incomparable does not adopt_version. Host tests: joined incomparable (18 vs 1, RFC |diff|>16), unjoined incomparable (17 vs 0), unjoined older (0 vs 5). Verify: cmake -S lichen/tests/rpl_dodag -B lichen/tests/rpl_dodag/build && cmake --build lichen/tests/rpl_dodag/build && ./lichen/tests/rpl_dodag/build/rpl_dodag_test → 13/13; ctest 1/1.
